Regulator‑facing Q&A outline (three focus areas): Complexity — one‑page plain‑language key‑facts, one numeric worked example, scripted adviser questions and retail gating (baseline: mandatory gating + simplified disclosure; aggressive: rely on key‑facts + adviser attestations); Digital‑asset exposure — clear statement of exposure magnitude, custody model, valuation methodology and stress scenarios (baseline: third‑party regulated custodian + conservative valuation haircuts; aggressive: contractual segregation and enhanced disclosure); Cross‑border distribution — entity map, controls (blocklists, platform attestations, transactional monitoring), and remedial powers (baseline: restrict retail sales from non‑local booking entities; aggressive: rely on contractual/technical controls and enhanced onboarding).
